findingDetails.title: HF-local availability accepts a ready server without proving it serves the requested model
findingDetails.evidence: canLoad ignores its model option and returns available for ready/loading; auto-select calls it without a model, while readiness returns after setting isHealthy false on a health-model mismatch and the next embed receives the server's 404.

adjudication.claim: HF-local availability can select a ready resident model that does not match the requested model.
adjudication.counterevidenceSought: Traced the default probe call, configured model selection, readiness latch and explicit server 404 mismatch response.
adjudication.alternativeExplanation: Deferred model validation might be intentional. Rejected because the probe result is persisted/selected and the server exposes an explicit loaded model while returning 404 on mismatch.
adjudication.downgradeTrigger: Demonstrate an explicit deferred-validation contract with rejection or fallback before active embedder persistence.

findingDetails.title: Direct HF Unix-socket path lacks a post-bind socket type check before chmod and close-time unlink

findingDetails.recommendation: lstat after bind and before chmod, require a real socket, and verify the node again before close-time unlink; add injected-fs symlink/non-socket cases.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared direct HF server path handling with shared IPC hardening; no unsafe live reproduction was run.
